welcomeSubtitle: All-in-One Offline Survival & Living Guide for Expats
selectLanguageDesc: All living guides, emergency hotlines, and utilities will be displayed in your chosen language. You can change it anytime in Settings.
searchPlaceholder: Search topics (e.g. visa, trash sorting, health insurance)
noSearchResults: No matching guides found. Try another search keyword.
tapToCall: Tap to make a direct call
trashDesc: Search any item to see whether it belongs to food, general, or recyclable waste, and which bag to use.
trashSearchPlaceholder: Search item name (chicken bones, banana peels, broken glass...)
trashRuleDesc: "Can animals eat this as processed feed?" Bones, clam shells, egg shells, and onion skins are GENERAL waste, NOT food waste!
visaDesc: Enter the expiry date on the back of your ARC to calculate remaining days and extension eligibility window.
visaExpiryLabel: Expiry Date on back of ARC
visaDaysLeft: {{days}} days left until expiry. (Application opens 4 months before expiry)
visaExpired: Your visa has expired! Please contact Immigration (1345) immediately.
visaEligibleText: You can now apply for an extension! (Up to 4 months before expiry)
visaEligibleSub: Visit HiKorea (hikorea.go.kr) to reserve an appointment or submit an e-application.
visaPlentyTime: Plenty of time remaining. Extensions can be filed starting 4 months (120 days) before expiry.
wageDesc: Calculate your net take-home pay based on the Korean Labor Standards Act, including statutory weekly holiday allowance (15+ hrs/week).
wageNote: Statutory weekly holiday allowance (주휴수당) is guaranteed by Korean law to all workers working 15+ hours/week who fulfill scheduled workdays.
checklistDesc: Step-by-step checklist of essential administrative and housing tasks from arrival to stable settlement.
notePlaceholderTitle: Title (e.g. HiKorea Booking #, Landlord Bank Account)
notePlaceholderContent: Jot down important numbers and information securely.
noteSecureInfo: Safely stored in your browser (LocalStorage) only. Never transmitted externally.
noSavedGuidesDesc: Tap the bookmark icon on any guide to save and access it anytime, even without an internet connection.
noNotesDesc: Record your ARC reference number, landlord contact details, door codes, and medical contacts.
pwaInstallDesc: Install directly onto your home screen for a fast, native app experience with full offline support.
pwaInstalled: Application is installed on your device.
offlineBanner: Running in offline mode. All data is cached on your device.
dataBackupDesc: Runs completely offline without server dependencies. Your notes and bookmarks stay on your phone.
resetSuccess: Local data has been reset to defaults.
